newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.193pts to 102.844.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.193pts to 102.844.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.193 points in Thursday's trading to 102.844, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.083 points to 2.277 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.078 points to 99.349 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.223 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 6.440 points to 1,054.042.
NOTE: The BICS 100 bond index was delayed on Thursday.
